crossChecks.currentness: EN VIGUEUR AU 26 OCTOBRE 2026; latest data update 11 October 2023; annex in force since that date.
crossChecks.observed: II-5.1 requires HIV, hepatitis B and hepatitis C markers within six months before the first concerned gamete collection or retrieval, including intraconjugal AMP. Footnote 93 defines a treatment attempt and does not impose an independent three-month sampling limit. II-5.2 separately addresses third-party gamete donors.
crossChecks.limit: This cross-check confirms current national wording and footnote, not clinical practice or completeness of all other binding sources.

crossChecks.currentness: EN VIGUEUR AU 26 OCTOBRE 2026; Article L332-7 in force since 5 March 2021.
crossChecks.pinpoint: Chapter II heading (L332-1 to L332-7); L332-7(I)–(IV)
crossChecks.observed: The current chapter heading ends at L332-7. Article L332-7 requires dynamic-price offers from suppliers serving more than 200,000 sites for qualifying smart-meter customers. It contains no fixed-price offer duty, and no L332-8 is shown in this chapter.
crossChecks.limit: Absence within this chapter does not by itself prove absence of every enforceable entitlement or private fixed-price offer.
